scenarios.description: Update of a non-existent task is not rejected with 404 (injected defect in the mocked baseline service).

defects.title: PATCH of an unknown task id does not return TASK_NOT_FOUND

evidence.observed_behavior: update(unknown-id, {completed: true}) resolves instead of throwing an error with statusCode 404 and code TASK_NOT_FOUND.
evidence.expected_behavior: update must confirm the task exists first and fail with statusCode 404 and code TASK_NOT_FOUND.

defects.explanation: SIMULATED explanation: the update path calls the repository without a prior existence check, so a phantom task can be created.
